exact_primal.weight_units: total labelled-root embedding mass assigned to a representative graph
exact_primal.normalized_distribution: divide each listed mass by the root mass
exact_primal.lift_justification: each row-orbit indicator averages to its coefficient divided by that orbit size

positive_psd_criterion: P symmetric and all coefficients of det(tI+P) nonnegative
positive_psd_proof: a negative eigenvalue would give a positive root of a monic polynomial with nonnegative coefficients
